records.real_world_identity_notes: The observation identifies the AMG-prepared Mercedes-Benz 190 E 2.5-16 Evolution II DTM touring car used in the 1992 Deutsche Tourenwagen-Meisterschaft. This is the race specification, not the 1990 road-going Evo II homologation special represented by the existing mercedes-benz-190e-2-5-16-evo-ii-dtm record. Mercedes-Benz describes the Evo II road car as the homologation basis for the DTM touring car and records the 1992 championship success; period/technical secondary evidence describes the 1992 DTM car as a six-speed straight-toothed race car shifted at full throttle without clutch use for upshifts. The exact selector gate, gearbox construction category, launch procedure, downshift clutch/blip procedure, automatic cut/blip behavior, and real wheel-rim topology are not established by the reviewed sources.
records.confidence_basis: Mercedes-Benz's official history identifies the 190 E 2.5-16 Evolution II as the homologation basis for the DTM touring car, dates the race debut to 1990, and records the 1992 title season. Auto Bild's exact 1992 DTM article identifies the AMG-prepared car and reports its six-speed straight-toothed gearbox and full-throttle clutchless shifting. The existing repository record is separately identified as a 1990 homologation special with five-speed synchromesh dogleg controls, so merging the 1992 race specification into it would mix distinct real-world configurations.
